brief:
A documentary video circulated on October 11, 2026, showed settlers intentionally poisoning their sheep on Palestinian land in the village of al-Mughayyir, northeast of Ramallah, according to Shehab Wire. The incident appeared designed to fabricate false accusations against Palestinians in the area.

The poisoning took place within the boundaries of Palestinian citizens' agricultural land, part of what the video documentation suggested was a staged operation to manufacture pretexts for further action against the community.

title: Settlers poison their own livestock in Palestinian village
